newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS to review Alliance credit rating.
newsitem.headline: DBRS to review Alliance credit rating.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said on Thursday that it is placing the credit rating for Alliance Forest Products under review with developing implications.

The review of the BB-high rating on Alliance's senior debt is in response to the recent announcement by Alliance of a proposed acquisition of the Coosa Pines facility in Alabama from Kimberly-Clark Corp, DBRS said.
The Coosa Pines facility includes a groundwood paper mill, pulp mill, sawmill and associated timberlands. Alliance is offering about US$600 million for the facility.

"With Alliance's current equity base near C$350 million, and debt near C$50 million, the financing of the Coosa Pines acquisition wil have a substantial impact on the company's balance sheet," DBRS said.
DBRS said it expects to meet with Alliance officials in January to evaluate the impact of the acquisition in greater detail and review the company's credit rating.
